items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Trummy Young came into the band, too... I used to look at him

ctx.x: Well, now, did you -- well, let me see, Trummy Young came into the band, too, didn't he?
Yeah. Great trombone player. And a lot of guys right today, Trummy practiced blowing in a pop bottle with a straw. He said Dorsey told him to do that in order to get that circular --
